caption:
Gemini can now clone a voice from a 30-second sample. Google just launched Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS: 2,000+ voices, 100+ languages, built-in consent checks. Here's how to try it in AI Studio + 4 prompts.

#gemini #google #ai #texttospeech #voicecloning #aitools

slides.title: Gemini can clone your voice.
slides.voiceover: Google just launched Gemini 3.8 TTS, and it can clone your voice.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: Two new text-to-speech models
items: Google AI Studio & Gemini API, now
slides.voiceover: Two models: Flash for creative work, Flash-Lite for high-volume use.

slides.label: Try it · AI Studio
slides.title: Clone a voice in 3 steps
steps: Pick the Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS model
A verbal consent clip from the voice owner is required
slides.voiceover: In AI Studio, record consent first, then upload a 30-second sample.

slides.label: Narration
slides.name: The Narrator
slides.prompt: Read the following script in a warm, calm, documentary-narrator voice, pausing naturally between sentences: [SCRIPT]
slides.note: Works with any of the 2,000+ built-in voices.
slides.voiceover: First, narrate a script in a warm documentary voice.

slides.label: Custom voice
slides.name: The Voice Clone
slides.prompt: Using my uploaded voice sample, say: [TEXT]. Keep the tone conversational and match my natural pace.
slides.note: Needs a 30-second sample plus a verbal consent recording.
slides.voiceover: Second, clone your own voice from a 30-second sample and consent clip.

slides.label: Multilingual
slides.name: The Translator
slides.prompt: Say this in [LANGUAGE] using a natural [REGIONAL ACCENT, e.g. Mexican Spanish] accent: [TEXT]
slides.voiceover: Third, generate the same line across a hundred-plus languages.

slides.label: Multi-character
slides.name: The Dialogue Builder
slides.prompt: Generate a conversation between [CHARACTER A] and [CHARACTER B] with distinct voices. [CHARACTER A] sounds [TRAIT], [CHARACTER B] sounds [TRAIT]. Script: [DIALOGUE]
slides.note: Assign a different voice and delivery style to each character.
slides.voiceover: Fourth, build a full dialogue with a different voice per character.

slides.label: Know the limits
slides.title: Before you clone a voice
items: Requires a verbal consent recording from the voice owner
Not available yet in the EEA, UK, Switzerland, Illinois, Texas or India
Every generated clip carries a SynthID watermark
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool news
slides.voiceover: Consent is mandatory, and it's not available everywhere yet.
